result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.contracted_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Contract an edge by merging its endpoints. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12133-L12221){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.contracted_edge(u, v, self_loops=True) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Given an edge between `u` and `v`, creates a new graph where `v` is merged into `u`. This is equivalent to `contract_nodes(u, v)` but explicitly requires that an edge exists between the nodes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [u]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Source endpoint of the edge (node ID or label). [v]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Target endpoint of the edge (node ID or label). This node will be removed. [self_loops]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True` (default), the contracted edge becomes a self-loop on `u`. If `False`, the contracted edge is removed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new graph with the edge contracted. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If either node does not exist. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If no edge exists between `u` and `v`. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - equivalent to `contract_nodes(u, v)` when edge `(u, v)` exists - raises ValueError if the edge doesn't exist - for undirected graphs, edge direction doesn't matter ## Examples {.doc-examples} Contract an edge: ::: {#b6efc20f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) # Contract edge A-B result = g.contracted_edge("A", "B") # Returns 2 (A and C) result.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#f9579f83 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns True (was B-C) result.has_edge("A", "C") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` True ``` ::: ::: Edge contraction in directed graphs: ::: {#d3d2b159 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) # Contract directed edge A->B result = g.contracted_edge("A", "B") # Now A->C exists (was B->C) ``` :::
